lines.zh: 我走在末地石上，光从我身上滑开。
lines.en: I walk on end stone and light slides off me.

lines.zh: 你看不见我的脚，只看见草在动。
lines.en: You cannot see my feet, only the grass moving.

lines.zh: 我的毛把光折到别处去了。
lines.en: My fur bends the light somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我落脚很轻，浮空岛经不起重踩。
lines.en: I step lightly; floating islands cannot bear weight.

lines.zh: 双尾在我身后分开，扫过紫颂叶。
lines.en: My twin tails part behind me and brush the chorus leaves.

lines.zh: 我走路没有影子，这省了很多事。
lines.en: I cast no shadow while walking, which saves trouble.

lines.zh: 边缘的石头松，我贴着内侧走。
lines.en: The edge stones are loose, so I keep to the inner side.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，看上去像没人来过。
lines.en: Where I step, it looks as if no one came.

lines.zh: 我的爪收进毛里，走路没声音。
lines.en: My claws retract into fur and my steps are silent.

lines.zh: 浮空岛在漂，我得跟着它走。
lines.en: The island drifts, and I must walk with it.

lines.zh: 我绕过紫颂树，它们会发出声音。
lines.en: I go around the chorus trees; they make noise.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴末端那两个球，很沉。
lines.en: The two spheres at my tail ends are heavy.

lines.zh: 我趴在岛边，看虚空慢慢转。
lines.en: I lie at the island's edge and watch the void turn.

lines.zh: 我的毛一动不动，光就穿过我。
lines.en: My fur holds still and light passes through me.

lines.zh: 我在舔前爪，舔到血就停下。
lines.en: I lick my foreclaw and stop when I taste blood.

lines.zh: 有末影人在远处，我们不打扰彼此。
lines.en: An enderman is far off; we leave each other alone.

lines.zh: 我试着隐形到连自己都看不见。
lines.en: I try to vanish so completely I cannot see myself.

lines.zh: 我的胃里空着，但我不急。
lines.en: My stomach is empty, and I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 岛边的紫颂果熟了，我不吃那个。
lines.en: The chorus fruit ripens at the edge; I do not eat it.

lines.zh: 我的双尾慢慢拍着石头，打拍子。
lines.en: My twin tails tap the stone, keeping time.

lines.zh: 虚空没有回声，我说话也没用。
lines.en: The void gives no echo; speaking is useless.

lines.zh: 我把自己晒得发暖，还是没有影子。
lines.en: I bask until warm and still cast no shadow.

lines.zh: 我在听岛下有没有东西在爬。
lines.en: I listen for anything crawling beneath the island.

lines.zh: 那两个球一转，光就散开一点。
lines.en: The spheres turn and the light scatters a little.

lines.zh: 我就在你面前，你却看别处。
lines.en: I am right in front of you, and you look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的瞬间，我挪了半步。
lines.en: In the moment you blink, I shift half a step.

lines.zh: 你的护甲映出了我的一角。
lines.en: Your armor reflected a corner of me.

lines.zh: 我在看你的喉咙，那里跳得厉害。
lines.en: I am watching your throat; it jumps a lot.

lines.zh: 你闻到血腥味了吗？那是我。
lines.en: Do you smell blood? That is me.

lines.zh: 我贴近你的脸，呼吸落在你皮肤上。
lines.en: I come close and my breath lands on your skin.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛找不到焦点，很正常。
lines.en: Your eyes cannot find focus; that is normal.

lines.zh: 我能看见你，因为我不靠光。
lines.en: I see you because I do not rely on light.

lines.zh: 你身后的空气动了一下，那是我。
lines.en: The air behind you moved; that was me.

lines.zh: 你握紧了剑，可你不知道往哪砍。
lines.en: You grip your sword but do not know where to swing.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛把你的倒影切碎了。
lines.en: My fur cuts your reflection into pieces.

lines.zh: 我想看看你怕到什么程度。
lines.en: I want to see how afraid you can become.

lines.zh: 别转身，转身会更慢。
lines.en: Do not turn around; turning will only slow you.

lines.zh: 你身上有末地的味道，你从门里来。
lines.en: You smell of the End; you came through the gate.

lines.zh: 血让我显形，这比疼更糟。
lines.en: Blood makes me visible, which is worse than pain.

lines.zh: 你怎么知道我在这里？
lines.en: How did you know I was here?

lines.zh: 我的毛被削掉一片，折光乱了。
lines.en: A patch of fur is cut and my bending is ruined.

lines.zh: 这一下打在肋骨上，我喘不上气。
lines.en: That hit my ribs and I cannot catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我退进阴影，可这里没有阴影。
lines.en: I retreat into shadow, but there is no shadow here.

lines.zh: 我的爪子还插在它身上，拔不出来。
lines.en: My claw is still in it and will not come out.

lines.zh: 看不见的伤口，血也是热的。
lines.en: The wound is unseen, but the blood is still warm.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，暴露了自己的位置。
lines.en: I roar and give away my position.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴球裂了一道缝。
lines.en: A crack has opened in my tail sphere.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，把软的地方藏起来。
lines.en: I arch my back and hide the soft places.

lines.zh: 血的味道，从你袖口飘出来。
lines.en: The smell of blood drifts from your sleeve.

lines.zh: 那块生肉放下，别抖。
lines.en: Put the raw meat down, and stop shaking.

lines.zh: 我不吃腐的，我要刚断气的。
lines.en: I do not eat rotten meat; I want what just died.

lines.zh: 你的伤口在渗，我闻得到。
lines.en: Your wound is seeping; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 猎物自己走过来，我很少遇到。
lines.en: Prey walking to me is rare.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Come one step closer and my patience ends.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴唇，这不是好兆头。
lines.en: I lick my lips; that is not a good sign.

lines.zh: 你把肉扔远点，我怕压坏它。
lines.en: Throw the meat farther; I do not want to crush it.

lines.zh: 饥饿让我的隐形不太稳。
lines.en: Hunger makes my invisibility unsteady.

lines.zh: 我能等，但不会等太久。
lines.en: I can wait, but not for very long.

lines.zh: 你撞到空气，然后撞到我。
lines.en: You hit the air, and then you hit me.

lines.zh: 我被撞得显形了一瞬。
lines.en: The impact makes me flicker into view.

lines.zh: 别用手摸，那会摸到爪子。
lines.en: Do not reach out; you will find claws.

lines.zh: 我们贴得太近，我的毛都竖了。
lines.en: We are too close, and my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 我退开，光又把我收起来了。
lines.en: I step back and the light takes me again.

lines.zh: 你的肩甲磕到了我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your shoulder plate knocks my ribs.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被碰到，尤其是看不见时。
lines.en: I dislike being touched, especially unseen.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的尾巴球，很疼。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail sphere; it hurts.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我暴露，这很危险。
lines.en: A collision exposes me, and that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，空气留下一条缝。
lines.en: I go around you, leaving a seam in the air.

lines.zh: 我们靠气味找彼此，不靠眼睛。
lines.en: We find each other by scent, not by sight.

lines.zh: 她的绒毛比我的更细，折光更狠。
lines.en: Her fur is finer than mine and bends light harder.

lines.zh: 两只隐形的兽相遇，只能听见呼吸。
lines.en: Two unseen beasts meet and can only hear breathing.

lines.zh: 我们用尾巴上的球轻碰，算作问候。
lines.en: We touch tail spheres lightly as a greeting.

lines.zh: 那一窝幼崽，出生时都不会隐形。
lines.en: The litter is born without any invisibility.

lines.zh: 她替我舔掉爪上的旧血。
lines.en: She licks the old blood from my claws.

lines.zh: 我们在同一块浮空岛上划了界。
lines.en: We marked a border on the same floating island.

lines.zh: 她的叫声很低，只有我能听见。
lines.en: Her call is low; only I can hear it.

lines.zh: 幼崽学会隐身前，要躲三个月。
lines.en: The young must hide three months before they vanish.

lines.zh: 她走后，空气里还留着她的形状。
lines.en: After she leaves, her shape remains in the air.

lines.zh: 这块末地石亮，我收着。
lines.en: This end stone is bright; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我叼起一枚紫颂果，又吐了。
lines.en: I pick up a chorus fruit and spit it out.

lines.zh: 你的剑掉了，我踩住它。
lines.en: You dropped your sword; I put my foot on it.

lines.zh: 我把骨头叼回巢里，磨爪子用。
lines.en: I carry a bone to the nest to sharpen my claws.

lines.zh: 亮的东西会破坏隐形，我不捡太多。
lines.en: Shiny things spoil invisibility, so I take few.

lines.zh: 那件披风不错，我拖进洞里了。
lines.en: That cloak is good; I dragged it into my den.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗珍珠，它还在响。
lines.en: I pick up a pearl and it is still humming.

lines.zh: 肉我当场吃，不带走。
lines.en: I eat meat on the spot and carry none away.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼着甲片，走得很小心。
lines.en: I carry an armor plate in my mouth and walk carefully.

lines.zh: 这里的东西都是别人丢的，我留下。
lines.en: Everything here was dropped by someone; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我在数你的步子，第三下重了。
lines.en: I am counting your steps; the third one lands heavy.

lines.zh: 有活物落在岛上，血是热的。
lines.en: Something living landed here, and its blood is warm.

lines.zh: 末影螨在石头下动，太小了。
lines.en: An endermite stirs under the stone, too small.

lines.zh: 那个人的甲上有我的抓痕。
lines.en: That one's armor bears my claw marks.

lines.zh: 风停了，气味就清楚了。
lines.en: The wind stops, and the scent becomes clear.

lines.zh: 我压低前半身，后腿收好力。
lines.en: I lower my front and gather strength in my hind legs.

lines.zh: 它背着光，看不见我，正好。
lines.en: It stands against the light and cannot see me; perfect.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴球开始发热。
lines.en: The spheres on my tails begin to warm.

lines.zh: 血的味道越来越近。
lines.en: The smell of blood is getting closer.

lines.zh: 它停下喘气，我知道该动了。
lines.en: It stops to pant, and I know it is time.

lines.zh: 猎物越慌，越容易犯错。
lines.en: The more panicked the prey, the more mistakes it makes.

lines.zh: 我把爪子从毛里伸了出来。
lines.en: I slide my claws out of the fur.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的脚踝，先断速度。
lines.en: I fix on its ankle to kill its speed first.

lines.zh: 它的甲护住胸口，护不住脖子。
lines.en: Its armor covers the chest, not the neck.

lines.zh: 我绕着它走，它听见声音却找不到。
lines.en: I circle it; it hears me but cannot find me.

lines.zh: 它开始乱挥，这会让它累。
lines.en: It starts swinging wildly, which will tire it.

lines.zh: 我数它的呼吸，第四下最浅。
lines.en: I count its breaths; the fourth is the shallowest.

lines.zh: 那两个球已经对准了它的眼睛。
lines.en: Both spheres are aimed at its eyes.

lines.zh: 它退到岛边，后面是虚空。
lines.en: It backs to the island's edge, with the void behind.

lines.zh: 等它抬脚，我就扑。
lines.en: When it lifts a foot, I pounce.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴先动，身体后动。
lines.en: My tails move first; my body follows.

lines.zh: 它以为我在左边，我在右边。
lines.en: It thinks I am on the left; I am on the right.

lines.zh: 它的血滴在石上，标出了位置。
lines.en: Its blood drops on the stone and marks its place.

lines.zh: 我忍住不出声，连呼吸都放轻。
lines.en: I hold silent, even softening my breath.

lines.zh: 它的膝盖弯了，就是现在。
lines.en: Its knee bends; now is the moment.

lines.zh: 前爪划过，皮肉翻开三层。
lines.en: My foreclaw rakes and the flesh opens in three layers.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的手腕，血涌出来。
lines.en: I bite its wrist and blood surges out.

lines.zh: 撕裂的声音比叫声还响。
lines.en: The sound of tearing is louder than the scream.

lines.zh: 它捂着伤口，血从指缝漏。
lines.en: It clutches the wound and blood leaks between its fingers.

lines.zh: 我从侧面扑上，爪子先着地。
lines.en: I pounce from the side, claws landing first.

lines.zh: 这一爪挑了它的筋。
lines.en: This claw has cut its tendon.

lines.zh: 它的血喷在我毛上，我显形了。
lines.en: Its blood sprays my fur and I become visible.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把咬下的东西吐掉。
lines.en: I shake my head and spit out what I bit off.

lines.zh: 它跪下的时候，我退开半步。
lines.en: When it kneels, I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬在它胸口，我借力弹开。
lines.en: My hind legs kick its chest and I spring away.

lines.zh: 伤口会一直流血，我知道。
lines.en: The wound will keep bleeding; I know that.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔爪子，收工。
lines.en: I lick my claws; the work is done.

lines.zh: 我从折跃门的光里掉下来，落在石上。
lines.en: I drop out of the gate's light onto the stone.

lines.zh: 落地时我还没有隐形，很短暂。
lines.en: I am not yet invisible when I land, but only briefly.

lines.zh: 这座浮空岛是新的，气味陌生。
lines.en: This floating island is new, and its scent is strange.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，光就被折走了。
lines.en: I shake my fur and the light is bent away.

lines.zh: 虚空在我脚下呼吸，很轻。
lines.en: The void breathes beneath me, very softly.

lines.zh: 我的双尾第一次展开，扫到石头。
lines.en: My twin tails spread for the first time and hit stone.

lines.zh: 紫颂树在我旁边，我不吃它。
lines.en: A chorus tree stands beside me; I do not eat it.

lines.zh: 远处有末影人在搬运石头。
lines.en: An enderman is carrying stone in the distance.

lines.zh: 我饿了，但先要找到水。
lines.en: I am hungry, but first I must find water.

lines.zh: 我的爪子还没磨过，很软。
lines.en: My claws have never been sharpened and are soft.

lines.zh: 我在岛的中心嗅了嗅，什么也没有。
lines.en: I sniff the island's center and find nothing.

lines.zh: 光从我背后过来，我正好藏进去。
lines.en: Light comes from behind me and I hide inside it.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，看见的第一个人会记住我。
lines.en: I open my eyes; the first person I see will remember me.

lines.zh: 火燎到毛尖，我整只亮了一下。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur tips and I flash into view.

lines.zh: 我从浮空岛掉下来，风撕着我的毛。
lines.en: I fall from the island and wind tears at my fur.

lines.zh: 末地没有水，这水让我更慌。
lines.en: The End has no water, and this water frightens me more.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，毛全乱了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my fur is a mess.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，留下一道红的线。
lines.en: An arrow passes through me and leaves a red line.

lines.zh: 药水沾上毛，我半边藏不住了。
lines.en: Potion soaks my fur and half of me cannot hide.

lines.zh: 饿到第三日，隐形开始断断续续。
lines.en: By the third hungry day, my invisibility comes and goes.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我比任何时候都清楚。
lines.en: In the lightning flash I am clearer than ever.

lines.zh: 虚空吞掉了光，我也被吞掉了。
lines.en: The void swallows the light, and me with it.
